chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings (and Terapeak): 'railway hand signal lamp', 'railway lantern 3 aspect', 'VR railway lantern', 'NSWGR lantern', 'Dietz railway lamp'; filter Sold, Australia, last 12 months. Also check LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable/Leski/Mossgreen for 'railway hand lamp'. Check whether marked (initials such as VR, NSWGR, SAR, TGR, PWD) lamps sell well above unmarked.
viewing_check: Look on the top cap, body, lens surround, door and base for stamped or punched railway initials (VR, NSWGR, TGR, SAR, QR, PWD), maker plate (Oldfield, Dietz, Bladon, Oxweld, Appleton), and date. Confirm all colour slides and lens glass are present and not cracked, burner complete, and rust has not perforated the body.
